note.question: How does a dike height optimization model to determine economically efficient flood protection standards?
note.overview: Flood prevention policy is of major importance to the Netherlands since a large part of the country is below sea level and high water levels in rivers may also cause floods. In this paper we propose a dike height optimization model to determine economically efficient flood protection standards. The model is nonconvex, but we derive an explicit simple expression for the global optimal solution, which is periodic.
